## How to read this

- **apps/** — deployable. Something runs it.
- **packages/** — imported by something else.
- **Depends on** lists workspace-internal dependencies only. External packages are in each
  `package.json`.

For domain rules, read `docs/ssot/`. For why the code is shaped this way, read `docs/adr/`.
This file only tells you where things are.
